description: Filter the dated launch-directory evidence by product fit, cost, format, and link policy. Use it when you are choosing where to list or launch a product and want a shortlist of directories that fit your product type, budget, listing format and backlink needs. Returns the matching directories from dated evidence with their recorded cost, format and link policy; it checks nothing live. Returns an evidence-bounded result and the canonical web tool URL.

cost.description: Whether getting listed costs money. free keeps directories with at least one free path, paid keeps those that only charge, unknown keeps those with no recorded price. any skips the filter.

dofollow.description: The recorded policy on whether the directory's backlink to your site passes SEO value (a followed link). conditional means it depends on a rule such as a plan or a rank. unknown means not yet verified. any skips the filter.

launchModel.description: How the directory presents a listing: time-boxed rankings (daily, weekly, monthly), a permanent evergreen listing, a community post, a review site, a deal marketplace, a tool database or a newsletter feature. any skips the filter.

segment.description: The kind of product you are launching, used to keep only directories that accept that kind of product. Use any to skip this filter.

name: toolfound_directory_matcher
title: Launch directory matcher
